对抗的结果取决于双方光环每月强度增长，可以将鼠标悬停在正下方£interface£恒星系预览面板中的光环图标来查看这一过程。
texts.en:
Our Psionic Aura has encountered another Aura in an adjacent connected system. When this occurs, the two Auras may compete to determine which will spread into the other system.

This process depends on the monthly Intensity gain of each opposing Aura, which can be observed by hovering over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £interface£ System View.
